projects.name: Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Wall Slip Behavior of Polypropylene Melt under Shear Flow
projects.summary: A simulation model of isotactic polypropylene melt in a confined flow field has been established. A program is currently under development to analyze the conformational evolution and wall slip under shear flow.

projects.name: Simulation of Mechanical Properties of Polydisperse Polyethylene Melt
projects.summary: The molecular dynamics simulation demonstrate that short-chain components in the polydisperse systems effectively balance regional stress concentrations through whole chain motion during the deformation of the polymer melt.
